back_translation: Take a break... take a KitKat
notes: I used the colloquial Gulf loanword 'بريك' (break), which Saudis commonly say, so the repetition and rhythm of the original survive, and I would avoid showing daytime snacking in any visuals during Ramadan, shifting 'break' moments to after iftar instead.
